rules.description: Change of control. Identify a change-of-control trigger, which party is subject to it, share-sale versus asset-sale applicability if stated, consent or notice, timing, exceptions and any termination consequence. Do not assume an assignment clause covers a share sale. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Assignment. Identify assignment, transfer, novation or subcontracting wording; consent/notice, permitted group transfers and carve-outs, and whether the proposed transaction is actually covered. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Exclusivity. Identify exclusivity, sole sourcing/distribution, territory/customer/product scope, duration, minimum obligations, exceptions and termination or competition-law review questions without deciding enforceability. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Non compete. Identify a non-compete or restrictive covenant, the restricted parties, activities, territory and duration, post-termination obligations and exceptions; flag legal applicability/enforceability as for counsel. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Termination. Identify termination rights, transaction/control triggers, convenience/default/cure, notice deadlines, licence/service continuity and survival consequences, including exceptions. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Liability caps. Identify aggregate/per-claim caps, amount or calculation basis, exclusions and carve-outs, uncapped liabilities and limitations. Do not treat a carve-out as a blanket cap or a liability exclusion as a monetary cap. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Governing law. Quote an express governing-law clause; distinguish governing law from forum/jurisdiction and document language. Record ambiguity or absence without inferring law from German or English wording. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.

Data protection. Identify contractual personal-data processing, controller/processor roles, processing agreements, security, breach notice, subprocessors, international transfer and change-related obligations if stated; do not assert statutory triggers without transaction facts and counsel. Return a document-specific candidate explanation and exact supporting wording. A lawyer must decide materiality, applicability and release.
